summary: Lucas Macaj, 23, of Colorado Springs hiked Longs Peak via the Keyhole Route on Sunday morning and texted a friend ~1 p.m. after summiting; he never returned. Significant storms that evening hampered NPS search efforts that began Monday. After four days of foot-and-drone searching, rangers found his body May 16 on Mills Glacier at the base of Lamb's Slide above Chasm Lake; initial investigation indicates a significant fall during his descent. Recovery by helicopter; body transferred to the Boulder County Coroner.
location: Longs Peak (Keyhole Route), Mills Glacier / Lamb's Slide above Chasm Lake
